messages:
marta (People Ops): quick q — manager flagged a new hire offer that would start the same week an internal promo is supposed to go live. they want to know evidence cutoffs, retro pay timing, and how equity grants line up if we merge headcount. any quick guidance?

josh (Eng Manager): ugh timing nightmare. if we convert candidate into an internal transfer, do we treat it as a hire or a comp change for payroll?

marta (People Ops): good Q. short answer: depends on whether it's a headcount add vs transfer. for transfers/role-changes where the person is moving from contractor/other team we treat as comp change. evidence and manager sign-off still required by the cutoff to hit the desired effective date.

sana (Recruiter): candidate has verbal accepted offer 4/8 and proposed start 5/4. manager wants promo effective 5/1 for the team slot. is that doable?

ethan (Payroll): payroll cutoffs: final comp_change_form + signed evidence must be in by 23:59 PT on the payroll cutoff date to make that month's payroll. usual cadence: cutoffs are the 10th of the month for 1st-month changes, and the 24th for mid-month batches. if you miss the cutoff we process retro on next cycle. cc @payroll-bot for auto-check.

marta (People Ops): so for your dates: offer accepted 4/8, start 5/4, promo effective 5/1 — need evidence & comp_change_form submitted by 5/10 cutoff to get it into May payroll. if submitted after 5/10 it'll be retroed in the next cycle (expect one payroll delay).

ethan (Payroll): requirements: manager sign-off + evidence doc + completed comp_change_form. submit via the intake form: https://hiring.redwood.com/evidence-upload or use the internal People Ops intake. payroll-bot will validate format and ack. example CSV we accept (simple):

```
employee_id,full_name,effective_date,new_base,grant_needed,manager
12345,Alex Rivera,2026-05-01,160000,yes,Josh Lee
```

marta (People Ops): equity note: if a new grant is needed we create the grant record once comp change is approved; grants follow the grant calendar and may take 2–3 business days to appear in the equity system. exercises/vesting schedules unaffected — just the grant creation timing.

alex (Hiring Manager): if we convert candidate to internal transfer on day 1, do we still need a separate offer for equity? or does the promo flow cover it?

marta (People Ops): if the person starts as a new hire under a fresh offer, equity comes from the offer. if they're an internal transfer and we're doing a comp_change + grant, we treat it as a separate grant request. either way: manager must attach the grant rationale in the evidence bundle.

josh (Eng Manager): for clarity — checklist for the team: 1) manager sign-off, 2) evidence (role scope + comp rationale), 3) comp_change_form, 4) if grant needed mark in form + attach rationale, 5) submit by cutoff.

sana (Recruiter): i'll sync candidate timeline with manager and push for forms this week. pinging @marta if we need a hard exception.

ethan (Payroll): exceptions: if you miss cutoff but need urgent correction for compliance reasons, open a payroll emergency ticket and include reason + org approval — we can sometimes do a manual adjustment but it's not guaranteed.

marta (People Ops): thanks — i'll post this checklist as a short doc in #people-ops resources. everyone: react with :thumbsup: when you have what you need or if you want me to escalate an exception.

payroll-bot: submission received: comp_change_form 12345.csv — validating... :white_check_mark:
